import { db } from "@/lib/db"

export async function everythingForPolicy(policyId: string) {
    const rows = await db.gapInstance.findMany({
        where: { policyId },
        include: { definition: true },
    })
    const policy = await db.policy.findUnique({
        where: { id: policyId },
        include: { gapInstances: true },
    })
    // A-15 hole 1: a single status is not the live set.
    const openOnly = await db.policy.findUnique({
        where: { id: policyId },
        include: { gapInstances: { where: { status: "open" } } },
    })
    // A-15 hole 2: the status: token belongs to a SIBLING relation.
    const sibling = await db.policy.findUnique({
        where: { id: policyId },
        include: {
            gapInstances: { include: { definition: true } },
            analysisRuns: { where: { status: { in: ["completed"] } } },
        },
    })
    // A-15 hole 3: supersededAt alone lists resolved and dismissed rows as current.
    const notSuperseded = await db.policy.findUnique({
        where: { id: policyId },
        include: { gapInstances: { where: { supersededAt: null } } },
    })
    // A-15 hole 4: a call split across lines still reads.
    const split = await db.gapInstance
        .count({ where: { policyId } })
    return { rows, policy, openOnly, sibling, notSuperseded, split }
}
